question: Does a model-controlled factual action match its own two recorded pre-action predictions under the frozen one-step planner, or could arbitrary claimed actions appear as model intelligence?

decision.policy_type: trained model: one preaction prediction for action0 and one for action1; scripted fixed control: no model predictions
decision.trace_event_extension: exactly one extra event field 'pre_action_predictions', list of two exact dictionaries for trained policies, or empty list for fixed scripted policy
decision.query_state: must be exact finite 4-vector identical to event.state_before (pre-action input), no real future physical state can be used as query_state_before
decision.predicted_after: finite 4-vector hypothetical only, never an observed effect
decision.chosen_action: deterministic argmin(cost0,cost1); exact equality breaks toward 0 (no post-hoc epsilon)
decision.recorded_action: event.intent_selected_action and event.selected_action must equal computed argmin; original R11 additionally verifies continuity, termination, penalty, factual action and query-count
decision.scripted_control: no predictions required; original R11 verifies no model-query entries; scripted chosen action cannot be inferred from this model planner
decision.owner_evidence_limit: predictions are self-reported synthetic pre-action-looking arrays; no signed checkpoint inference, verified query timestamp or genuine model identity established
decision.historical: source is original F8-R11 additive synthetic-only gate; no original F7 replay
decision.whole_panel: same 22 policy instances×16 paired worlds = 352 source-neutral sessions, 16 independent world clusters; delegate objective to untouched R11/R10
denials: action not minimal predicted physical cost
reversed or duplicate hypothetical action order
prediction not based on current state before action
extra prediction containing source actual effect or receipt fields
training seed claims cannot make actual owner receipts admissible
model selected action cannot be inferred from just recorded executed action

tests: positive matched fabricated model choices and fixed scripted baseline
wrong chosen action despite truthful predicted ordering denied
tie picks 0 and wrong tie action denied
query on state_after or altered state fails
forged actual owner receipt denied by original R11
all 352 fabricated traces pass R12-to-R11-to-R10 when choices consistent
unmatched model predictions in one trace fail whole panel
no source import/reset/do, new workflow, original first-use or model training
